expert.name: Aiko
expert.quote: Thirteen days with both Disney parks and Universal, and still enough free days that nobody is worn out by the end.
expert.tip: Do DisneySea on a weekday if you can, and start at Journey to the Center of the Earth before the queues build.

summary: Thirteen days at a comfortable pace: five nights in Shinjuku with a city tour, Mount Fuji and Hakone and both Disney parks, two in Kyoto with a Kyoto and Nara day, then four in Osaka with Universal Studios Japan, a walking tour and free days.
included: Included: 12 nights with daily breakfast; bullet trains between the cities; private airport transfers; a full day of guided sightseeing in Tokyo with lunch; the Mount Fuji fifth station and Lake Ashi, returning by bullet train; admission to Tokyo Disneyland; a one day passport for Tokyo DisneySea; a guided day through Kyoto and Nara with a buffet lunch; admission to Universal Studios Japan; a guided walk through central Osaka.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Japan visa fees; other lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
